items.summary_en: People gathered on Garvaghy Road in County Monaghan to stop an Orange Order parade from passing through. Police moved the crowd and traffic onto side roads. The march could not go through the village as planned.

items.raw_excerpt: Brisbane will get the chance to send retiring club legend Ali Brigginshaw out a winner in the grand final after it overpowered Gold Coast 20-8 at Robina.
items.summary_en: The Brisbane Broncos won 20-8 against the Gold Coast Titans at Robina to reach their fifth NRLW grand final. Club legend Ali Brigginshaw will retire after the final. Brisbane fans can watch her play her last game.
items.summary_ko: 브랜코스가 로비나에서 골드코스트 타이탄스를 20대 8로 이기고 다섯 번째 NRLW 결승에 진출했다. 선수 Clube의 터줏대기인 알리 브리그인쇼는 이 결승을 마지막 경기로 은퇴한다. 브랜베른 팬들은 그녀의 마지막 경기를 볼 수 있다.
items.title_en: Broncos beat Titans to reach fifth NRLW grand final

items.title_original: Broncos into fifth NRLW grand final after toppling Titans

items.raw_excerpt: This is Loh's first win over Christie in 11 meetings.
items.summary_en: Singapore badminton player Loh Kean Yew beat the world number one, Christie, in a men's singles game. It was his first win over her in 11 meetings. He is now sure to take a medal at the Asian Games, a first for Singapore.

items.raw_excerpt: Why would a hospital be laughing at charity? This is one of those French expressions that doesn't translate literally.
items.summary_en: This is a French saying that does not translate word for word. It means a person who accepts help but still acts proud and ungrateful. Here is how locals really use it.

items.raw_excerpt: Electricity distributor Jemena has been replacing 7-metre wooden power poles with 15-metre industrial poles rated to carry up to 66,000 volts, but there's been one consistent complaint among the residents where this is happening.
